Caption: {loser} puts it out
Notes: The ball is near a touchline when play stops: it goes out over the NEAREST one and the other side throws it in. The thrower chooses ATTACK or DEFEND, as before.

Caption: {loser} puts it out
Notes: From the middle the ball can still be put out over the nearest touchline. Lower this and drop balls come up more often in the middle.

Caption: The referee stops play
Notes: Play stops in the middle: the referee drops the ball where it is and both sides go for it - the old clash. The winner attacks.

Caption: {loser} puts it behind his own goal
Notes: A defender near his OWN goal line gives it away behind: the other side takes a CORNER from the corner flag and attacks (your Q061).

Caption: {loser} puts it over the goal line
Notes: An attacker near the goal he is attacking puts it over: the defending side takes a GOAL KICK and attacks (Q061).

Caption: {keeper} claims it from {loser}
Notes: An attacker loses it near goal and the keeper catches it. The keeper's side restarts from his hands and attacks (Q061).

Caption: A gust of wind takes the ball
Notes: RARE. The storm blows the ball somewhere else on the pitch; a random side gets there first and its player chooses ATTACK or DEFEND.
